item.title: Akame 48 Waterfalls: A Valley of Cascades and Ninja Legend — Guide
item.description: The Akame 48 Waterfalls are a beautiful forested ravine in western Mie where a well-built riverside trail threads past a long succession of cascades — not literally 48, but dozens, including several named grand falls — over a round-trip of roughly 4 kilometres. The valley is lushly green and cool, home to the protected Japanese giant salamander (which can be seen at a small centre at the entrance), and steeped in legend as a training ground of the Iga ninja, a heritage that lives on in ninja-experience programs offered on site.
